vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-1872: bug(cli): pan start crashes when sync-main hits a conflict — retroactive verification plan

plan.title: bug(cli): pan start crashes ('Cannot read ... toUpperCase') when sync-main hits a conflict — agent never spawns, conflicted issues unrecoverable
plan.author: agent:claude-sonnet-4-6

narratives.Problem: pan start on an in_review issue whose feature branch conflicted with main crashed with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toUpperCase)' after sync-main aborted. The work agent was never spawned, leaving conflicted issues permanently stranded.
narratives.Proposal: Fix was applied directly to main as commit 7297d2469c (2026-06-14). This retroactive plan has a single verification bead: run the regression test suite and typecheck to confirm the fix is in place, then signal completion so the issue closes through the pipeline.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No new implementation is needed; fix is already on main.
- This plan does not add automatic conflict resolution; resolving git conflicts is the work agent's responsibility after being spawned into a conflicted workspace.
- This plan does not redesign the sync-main flow or the start command architecture.
- This plan does not add UAT browser verification; the fix is CLI-only.

autoDecisions.summary: Retroactive planning: fix was applied directly to main before planning ran
autoDecisions.rationale: Commit 7297d24 (2026-06-14) landed the full fix with tests before the pipeline could plan it. The correct approach is a single verification bead, not re-implementing the fix.

autoDecisions.summary: No new commits required from the work agent
autoDecisions.rationale: The workspace is at the same tip as main. The work agent verifies existing tests pass and calls pan done; no code changes are expected.

items.title: Verify PAN-1872 regression fix is in place: run targeted test suite and typecheck

expected_outputs: start-sync-main-conflict.test.ts: 4 tests pass — 'continues to spawn the agent when sync-main reports a conflict', 'reuses a stopped agent model when sync-main conflicts before spawning', 'reports kickoff delivery failure with non-zero exit while preserving the live session', 'preserves success output when kickoff delivery was confirmed'
typecheck completes with no new errors

narrative.Action: Run the three verify commands above from the workspace root (bun install first if node_modules is absent). Confirm all 4 tests in start-sync-main-conflict.test.ts pass, all tests in work-agent-prompt-pan-1872.test.ts pass, and typecheck is clean. This bead requires NO code changes — the fix is already in main at commit 7297d2469c. If any test fails, report the failure and do NOT attempt to fix it in this session; file a follow-up issue instead. Once all checks pass, call pan done.
